يبتغيان (form VIII)
# يَبْتَغِيَانِ (yabtaḡiyāni) /jab.ta.ɣi.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# يُبْتَغَيَانِ (yubtaḡayāni) /jub.ta.ɣa.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
